renderer: PlanarCityLoc utils.lod.LoD.render_edges_batch; full mesh; no pose optimization
selection: Archived ambiguity examples only where all methods have a saved pose. Each UAV split is filled to five additional examples using filename-ordered quantiles from common MoGe-2 ViT-S saved predictions (10%, 35%, 65%, 90% for four, evenly spaced from 10% to 90% for five). Original paper examples are excluded. Not selected by pose error.
caveat: Saved additional experiments, not a new evaluation or a claim of exact full-table protocol. All baselines are the same SAM 3 v2 / oracle-mask v3 archives used by the paper figure.
